# waroom_service_architecture_context (Resource)

Manages a Waroom service architecture context. The architecture context is a Markdown document describing the architecture of a service. Each service has exactly one architecture context.

~> **Note:** The Waroom API has no endpoint to delete an architecture context. Creating this resource overwrites any existing architecture context of the service, and destroying it only removes it from the Terraform state; the content remains in Waroom.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "waroom_service_architecture_context" "example" {
  service_name = "my-service"
  blob         = <<-EOT
    # Architecture

    - Web: Ruby on Rails on ECS
    - Database: Aurora PostgreSQL
    - Cache: ElastiCache for Redis
  EOT
}

# The content can also be loaded from a Markdown file.
resource "waroom_service_architecture_context" "from_file" {
  service_name = "my-other-service"
  blob         = file("${path.module}/architecture.md")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blob` (String) The content of the architecture context, in Markdown. Must not be empty.
- `service_name` (String) The name of the Waroom service the architecture context belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Architecture context ID. This is an alias for `service_name`, since there is one architecture context per service.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The architecture context is imported by the name of its service (one per service).
terraform import waroom_service_architecture_context.example my-service
```
